name: Shubham Khanapure
title: Senior ML Engineer
subtitle: Generative AI & Computer Vision Specialist
summary: Senior ML Engineer with 6+ years building production AI/ML systems at scale. Specialized in Generative AI (LangChain, agentic RAG, LLMs) and Computer Vision (YOLO, object detection, OCR). Expert in Python, PyTorch, Azure ML, end-to-end MLOps pipelines, and distributed systems. Proven track record of reducing manual effort by 70-80% through AI automation, developing enterprise-scale GenAI applications, and delivering scalable production solutions in financial services and engineering automation domains.

cloud_data: Azure (ML Workspace, Databricks, Cognitive Services, Data Labeling, DevOps, Web Apps, Blob Storage, Container Registry)

experience.role: Data Scientist - Generative AI & Computer Vision
description: Developed production-grade P&ID Functional Specification Generation (FSG) system processing high-resolution complex engineering diagrams using YOLO object detection, Azure Custom Vision, and Azure Document Intelligence; built end-to-end pipeline on Azure ML Studio with data labeling, model training via Azure Jobs, and tag text extraction using DocTR OCR with intelligent object-to-tag spatial mapping algorithms.

Architected production-level microservices using Flask deployed on Azure Web Apps serving real-time predictions; integrated with Azure ML Workspace for model versioning and serving, implemented comprehensive experiment tracking with MLflow, utilized Azure Blob Storage for artifacts and datasets, and established automated training pipelines with Azure Jobs handling high-resolution complex P&IDs with robust preprocessing workflows.

Built agentic RAG system using LangGraph multi-agent architecture for automated functional specification document generation; designed specialized agents for extraction, validation, and content generation with Guardrails AI validation ensuring compliance with engineering standards and document quality.

Implemented NLP and OpenCV solutions for real-time workforce monitoring system processing employee interactions with automated activity classification and tracking; built multi-modal OCR pipeline using EAST/CRAFT text detection with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, and DocTR for recognition processing large-scale financial data via PySpark on Azure Databricks.

Engineered system performance monitoring infrastructure tracking CPU, RAM, and disk utilization in UAT environment; implemented automated dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana reducing production incidents through comprehensive performance metrics, alerting, and system reliability improvements.

Built end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Docker containerization with Azure Container Registry; established automated testing frameworks achieving high code coverage and enabling regular production releases with comprehensive deployment automation and version control.

Developed and deployed production GenAI applications using GPT-4, Azure OpenAI, and LangChain serving enterprise users; reduced manual business process effort by 70-80% through automated workflows including RFP response generation, document analysis, and intelligent search systems achieving significant operational efficiency improvements.

Designed enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture with semantic search using sentence transformers and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate); built full-stack AI applications using Django and FastAPI deployed on Azure Web Apps with auto-scaling, A/B testing, and continuous integration workflows.

Performed LLM fine-tuning and optimization using LoRA/QLoRA techniques improving inference efficiency; established MLOps pipelines with automated model retraining, versioning using MLflow, and monitoring for production ML systems achieving significant cost reduction while maintaining quality.
Recipient of KPMG Megastar Award and KPMG Encore Kudos Award for exceptional performance and innovation in AI/ML project delivery.

Developed and deployed supervised and unsupervised ML models using PyTorch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost; built automated ticket routing system achieving 88% classification accuracy, implemented NLP pipelines for text classification and NER using BERT and spaCy achieving high F1-scores, and built automated data processing pipelines using Apache Airflow with PCA/LDA dimensionality reduction.
